purpose: Exact official sources that upgrade the 4 anchor-only corridors from derived_pending_validation -> measured. Companion to THAILAND-DEMAND-HARDENING-CLOSURE-2026-06-22.json.
rule: A corridor moves to 'measured' only when an official primary source (AOT / Marine Department of Thailand / DNP / TAT) supplies a throughput or seat-capacity number that replaces the derived volume input. Operator/list fares already source-backed; this list is volume-locks only. null beats confidently-wrong.

tier_ladder.tier_1_official_primary: AOT airport stats, Marine Department passenger manifests, DNP national-park visitor statistics, TAT provincial arrival data. Upgrades to 'measured'.
tier_ladder.tier_2_operator_published: Ferry operator published seat capacity x sailings x stated load factor (Lomprayah/Seatran/Raja/Ao Nang Princess). Upgrades to 'derived_high_confidence' not 'measured'.
tier_ladder.tier_3_aggregator: Direct Ferries / Rome2Rio / Tripadvisor listings. Anchor only; never 'measured'.

global_upgrade_sources.AOT: airportthai.co.th monthly traffic reports - Samui is Bangkok Airways (not AOT); use AOT for Phuket & Krabi, Bangkok Airways investor/traffic data for Samui exact 2024-2025 split.
global_upgrade_sources.Marine_Department: md.go.th - provincial marine offices hold pier-level passenger manifests; the durable primary source for ferry corridor volumes.
global_upgrade_sources.DNP: dnp.go.th - national park visitor statistics; the durable primary source for Phang Nga Bay / marine-park day-tour pools.
global_upgrade_sources.TAT_MOTS: mots.go.th - provincial tourism arrival statistics; gateway/island arrival proxies.

note_samui_correction: Samui Airport is operated by Bangkok Airways, NOT AOT. The queue's 'AOT monthly Samui arrivals' line should chase Bangkok Airways traffic data for the exact 2024-2025 Samui split; AOT applies to Phuket/Krabi.

Koh Samui (Maenam) -> Koh Tao.official: Koh Tao ~500,000 visitors/yr (UNDP/BIOFIN); boat-only island => visitor count ~= boat arrivals.
Koh Samui (Maenam) -> Koh Tao.residual: Origin split (Samui vs Chumphon vs Phangan) pending Marine Dept Surat Thani.

Phuket -> Krabi / Ao Nang.correction: Krabi airport = Department of Airports (DOA), NOT AOT.
Phuket -> Krabi / Ao Nang.residual: Klong Jilad Pier ferry throughput pending Krabi Marine Office.

Ao Nang -> Railay.note: No published cooperative/TAT Railay figure found; stays derived. Krabi airport 2.32M bounds the province pool. null beats confidently-wrong.

Phang Nga Bay day-tour cluster.official: Ao Phang Nga National Park 999,035 visitors (2019, DNP); FY2024 DNP system +17.7% supports ~1.0M steady-state.
Phang Nga Bay day-tour cluster.residual: Per-pier departure split (Ao Po/Bang Rong) optional cross-check.
